trackRecord.title: Deliveries that earn repeat trust, year after year.
trackRecord.intro: In 2025–2026, MIU competed in open tenders held by organizations in Mongolia's mining, energy and public-transport sectors, and successfully delivered 14 contracts across the following categories.

items.text: Instrumentation and temperature-sensor supply (JUMO) — two consecutive years
KIP instrumentation and automation equipment supply
Spare parts for steel grinding-ball production equipment
Foundry mould equipment spare parts (FAT)
Electrical components: magnetic contactors, relays, contact blocks (Schneider Electric)
Pneumatic system fittings and actuators (FESTO)
Crane speed limiters
Water-treatment equipment spares and protective cartridges
Industrial batteries and measuring devices
Spare parts and components for Ulaanbaatar's public-transport bus fleet (Yutong · Golden Dragon · County)

trackRecord.closing: «Эрдэнэт үйлдвэр» ТӨҮГ and «Зорчигч тээвэр төв» ОНӨААТҮГ have both signed new contracts with MIU in 2025 and 2026 alike — evidence of an ongoing working relationship.
